response.rationale: Both forms refer to a parcel sent through postal services. Indonesian commonly uses kiriman paket, while Malaysian postal usage favors kiriman bungkusan; this is a useful variety-based contrast.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian usage may also prefer the fuller postal expression bungkusan pos in some contexts.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Paket is understood and used in Malaysian Malay, but bungkusan is the more credible Malaysian postal term; the contrast remains useful rather than exclusive.
